events.name: New York Giants at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: Jay Cutler threw two touchdown passes to Brandon Marshall, and Tim Jennings had two of the Chicago Bears' three interceptions against Eli Manning in a 27-21 victory over the winless New York Giants on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bears pick off Eli 3 times, send Giants to 0-6

headlines.description: Mike Nugent hit a 43-yard field goal with 6:44 left in overtime to lift the Cincinnati Bengals to a 27-24 win over the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals beat Bills on Nugent's OT field goal

events.name: Oakland Raiders at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Jamaal Charles ran for two touchdowns, the Kansas City defense harassed Oakland quarterback Terrelle Pryor into throwing three second-half interceptions and the Chiefs remained unbeaten with a 24-7 victory over the Raiders on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs stymie Raiders to remain undefeated

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw for three touchdown passes and ran for another score, and the Panthers romped past Adrian Peterson and the Minnesota Vikings 35-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton shines as Panthers blister Vikings

events.name: Pittsburgh Steelers at New York Jets

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger threw a 55-yard touchdown pass to Emmanuel Sanders, Shaun Suisham kicked four field goals, and the Pittsburgh Steelers won their first game of the season, beating the New York Jets 19-6 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers throttle Jets for 1st win of season

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Nick Foles threw three touchdown passes and ran for a fourth, leading the Philadelphia Eagles to a 31-20 victory over the winless Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Foles throws 3 TDs, leads Eagles past Bucs

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Baltimore Ravens

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw a 64-yard touchdown pass to Jordy Nelson, Mason Crosby kicked four field goals and the Green Bay Packers held on to beat the Baltimore Ravens 19-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodgers, Lacy help Packers hold off Ravens

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Houston Texans

headlines.description: Sam Bradford threw three touchdown passes, St. Louis added a score on defense and special teams and the Rams stunned the mistake-prone Houston Texans with a 38-13 win on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bradford-led Rams roll, extend Texans' skid

headlines.description: Peyton Manning threw for two scores and Knowshon Moreno ran for three to lead the Denver Broncos to a tougher-than-expected 35-19 victory Sunday over the winless Jacksonville Jaguars.
headlines.shortLinkText: Moreno runs for 3 TDs as Broncos slip Jags

headlines.description: Marshawn Lynch ran for two touchdowns and had 155 all-purpose yards, Richard Sherman came up with his third interception of the season, and the Seattle Seahawks finally shook the Tennessee Titans in the fourth quarter for a 20-13 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks overcome mistakes to top Titans

events.name: New Orleans Saints at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Pats stun Saints 30-27 on TD with 5 seconds left
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady throws late TD as Patriots slow Saints

headlines.description: Vernon Davis caught touchdown passes of 61 and 35 yards and finished with a career-best 180 yards receiving, leading the San Francisco 49ers past the Arizona Cardinals 32-20 on Sunday for their third straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Davis' big day fuels 49ers' 3rd straight win

headlines.description: Dwayne Harris returned a punt 86 yards for a touchdown and set up another score with a 90-yard kickoff return as the Dallas Cowboys handed Robert Griffin III his first loss in his home state with a 31-16 victory against the Washington Redskins on Sunday
headlines.shortLinkText: Harris' big return night carries Cowboys to win

events.name: Indianapolis Colts at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw a 22-yard touchdown pass to rookie Keenan Allen and Nick Novak kicked four field goals for the San Diego Chargers, who used long drives to keep Andrew Luck off the field in a 19-9 victory against the Indianapolis Colts on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers limit Luck, roll past Colts
